alignment.note: The Vulgate completely omits the Isaiah 66:24 quotation ('where their worm does not die and the fire is not quenched') attested in both Greek and Peshitta witnesses. Instead, the Vulgate transmits an entirely different saying about salt and sacrifice (Mark 9:49), reflecting a major textual tradition divergence at this point in the Gospel.

The Vulgate alone attests 'Omnis enim igne salietur, et omnis victima sale salietur' (For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be salted with salt), a logion absent from both the Greek NA28 and Peshitta at this location. This represents a distinct textual tradition, possibly reflecting Western manuscript influence or liturgical harmonization with sacrificial imagery from Leviticus 2:13.
